cohort: The study included 641 term parturients with placental examination during 2005.
finding: Epidural analgesia, histologic chorioamnionitis, birthweight, vaginal exams, and duration of ruptured membranes were independent predictors of intrapartum fever, while parity ≥1 and thick meconium were inversely associated.
birth_weight: Birthweight was measured as a continuous variable and found to be an independent predictor of intrapartum fever.
